events.name: Bash
events.head: Check fix ancestry and rate-limit code
events.input: $ git fetch -q origin && git log -1 --format='%h %ci' origin/main && git merge-base --is-ancestor a67da2c origin/main && echo ANCESTOR; git show --stat --format='%h %s' a67da2c | head -8; grep -n "rate\|limit\|429\|tries" cloud/src/webinar.ts | head -30

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read rate-limit block and list deployments
events.input: $ sed -n 40,62p cloud/src/webinar.ts; git diff --stat origin/main -- cloud/src/webinar.ts app/scripts/probe-webinar-signup.mjs; cd cloud && npx wrangler deployments list --name revops-centre 2>/dev/null | grep -E "Created|Version" | tail -4
